messages:
sophia: saw the latest mock for the rollout mini-timeline. love the scrubber but worried about discoverability on dense release histories.
rene: agree. if teams have 40+ versions the scrubber thumb gets tiny. maybe add left/right arrow jumps to next major milestone.
pat: can we reduce visual noise by collapsing consecutive canaries into a single line item with a sub-count? e.g., 'Canaries (3)' then expand on click.
sophia: good idea. accessibility note: expansion needs aria-expanded toggles and keyboard support (space/enter).
mina: copy thought for rollback confirmation modal: current text: 'Are you sure you want to rollback?' -> propose: 'Rollback to the last stable version? This will stop the current rollout and route traffic to the previous version.' makes impact explicit.
kevin: +1 on explicit. also add a small "Expected user impact" line so product owners can see which routes will change.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp complete: 5% -> 25% -> 60% (automated).
rene: visual contrast nit: the canary indicator (yellow) barely meets 3:1 against the bg. lmk if you want me to pick WCAG-compliant hexes.
sophia: please do. we need accent colors for: canary, full-release, rolled-back, and paused. keep them distinct for color-blind palettes.
pat: suggestion: use patterns/stripes on top of color for additional visual distinction (for tiny indicators).
mina: keyboard flow test: tab order currently goes: timeline scrubber -> commit list -> actions. need scrubber -> commit -> actions -> modal close. Don't trap focus inside the commit details when opened.
kevin: engineering question: can the scrubber emit an accessible live region with summary text like 'Selected: version #12, canary 30%' to help screen readers?
sophia: yes, add a sr-only live region with role="status" and polite politeness. also include `aria-atomic=true` so partial updates aren't read.
rene: color picks (draft): canary #E2B400 (alt #D18F00), full-release #1471E0, rolled-back #6C6C6C, paused #FF8A65. these are tuned for 4.5:1 contrast on our background.
pat: testing: i'd like two microcopy variants for the rollback CTA in the timeline:
- Variant 1: 'Rollback to previous stable'
- Variant 2: 'Stop rollout and restore stable'
we'll measure time-to-action and help-center searches.
sophia: also propose changing small inline action labels to verbs not nouns (e.g., 'Rollback' -> 'Revert deployment') for clarity. we'll include both in the A/B.
mina: i'll add an a11y checklist to the PR: focus order, live region announcements, aria labels on scrubber, contrast check, keyboard-expandable rows, and screen reader text for condensed indicators.
kevin: implementation note: i'll add data attributes: data-state, data-percent, data-version to each timeline node for tests. and ensure the scrubber thumb is at least 24px target.
sophia: great. next steps: kevin to update prototype, mina to write checklist in PR body, rene to finalize alternate hexes for accessibility, pat to prepare copy variants and QA plan. ship to internal beta tomorrow.
sophia: tagging @design-review for any last-minute eyes. :mag:
